samples.title: Hello World
samples.description: A general demonstration of platform capabilities — authentication, REST CRUD, paged lists, Microsoft Graph, Power Automate, JSON file loading, metrics dashboard, and auto-provisioning.

samples.title: Guestbook
samples.description: Demonstrates using SharePoint Lists as a database — auto-provisions its list and custom fields on first run, creates entries through a validated form, and renders them with live search. Single-file app styled with the sample design system.

samples.title: Executive Metrics Dashboard
samples.description: A dynamic metrics dashboard demonstrating JSON file-driven data visualization, sparklines, status thresholds, and large dataset rendering entirely client-side.

samples.title: Markdown File Viewer
samples.description: An artifact that renders a Markdown file as formatted HTML — headings, code blocks, tables, and inline styles — entirely client-side with no dependencies.

samples.title: JSON Viewer
samples.description: An artifact that renders arbitrary JSON as a collapsible, syntax-highlighted tree — useful for exploring API responses and data structures.

samples.title: CSV Merge Report
samples.description: Pattern B (Script) — merges every CSV in an input folder into one formatted Excel workbook with a summary sheet. Demonstrates PEP 723 metadata, the approved stack (pandas, openpyxl, rich), %LOCALAPPDATA% logging, and run-to-completion terminal output.

samples.title: Data Explorer
samples.description: Pattern C (Streamlit) — an interactive localhost dashboard over a tabular dataset with upload, filters, metrics, charts, and CSV download. Demonstrates the self-bootstrapping launcher, st.session_state, and localhost-only binding.

samples.title: SQL Schema Explorer
samples.description: Pattern C (Streamlit) — a read-only explorer for SQL Server: browse schemas, tables, and views, inspect columns, preview sample rows, and download as CSV. Demonstrates mssql-python with the user's own identity and parameterized metadata queries.

samples.title: EUDA Worker
samples.description: The reference worker app — sign in, join the pool, and watch your machine win and lose claims in real time. Includes the one-click race proof (N simultaneous claims, exactly one winner) and the weather-to-json demo job.

samples.title: Worker Pool Status
samples.description: The read-only pool dashboard — schedules with due-state, recent runs, machines seen in the last 24 hours, and the latest job output. For everyone who isn't running a worker.
